Conservez les identifiants propres à cha: Keep the unique identifiers of each tool and their correspondence after a validated reconciliation. Distinguish person and company, as well as the common addresses used by several interlocutors. For the telephone, name or address, indicate the source selected and the known date of modification. An empty data must not erase existing information without explicit rules.
Exemple illustratif : deux interlocuteur: Example: two business contacts use the same service address. The system proposes a business reconciliation, but does not automatically merge people. A manager then links the right files and keeps the identifiers of the two contacts for the following exchanges.
La synchronisation dépend des possibilit: Synchronization depends on the real possibilities of software and rights granted. It does not guarantee the quality of the initial data. Removals, mergers and contact restrictions require company-specific rules and should not be inferred from a mere similarity.
Lorsqu’une correspondance reste incertai: When a match remains uncertain, present the cards and their differences in a check queue. A merger must maintain relations with requests and messages, without losing history. Contact oppositions and restrictions must not disappear when copying data. Provide a record of the decision and a means to correct an erroneous reconciliation in the tools involved.
Modifiez un contact dans un outil, puis: Edit a contact in a tool, then check that the sync return does not create an update loop. Test two people with the same name, a collective address and a write-off in one system. A recovery must be made again. Supervision distinguishes a synchronized field, a conflict to be resolved and a temporarily unavailable connector.

Un contact peut apparaître dans la messa: A contact may appear in the messaging, CRM and a management tool with different information. Synchronization should specify which source is authoritative for each field and how to deal with conflicts. A similar name or a shared address is not sufficient to say that two cards represent the same person.
